answer: Sybil resistance can come from verifiable delay functions: each new agent identity must run a sequential VDF that takes about a day, like a glacier creeping forward, and cannot be parallelized. A comet-fast swarm of 1,000 fakes still needs 1,000 separate delay proofs and hardware time, so the attacker pays in waiting and compute; honest agents can start at dawn and be admitted by the next.
